cohort: COVID-19-positive pregnant women admitted for delivery at a tertiary care center in Chamarajanagar, India
finding: There were no maternal or neonatal deaths; however, premature rupture of membranes, decreased oxygen saturation, and low birth weight were observed in some cases, with one instance of vertical COVID-19 transmission.
mod_finding: Lower segment cesarean section was the commonest mode of delivery (38.7%).
birth_weight: The mean birth weight of the neonates was 2.97 +/- 4.89 kg
